static_traits.name: Chen Wei
static_traits.medical_history: No history of similar psychological problems; never received psychotherapy; no significant physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Cooperative, positive attitude, clear expression, able to reflect on own thought patterns

basic_info.main_problem: After hearing an unpleasant classical music piece, I developed a negative view of classical music, believing all classical music will be terrible from now on. This has affected my enjoyment of something I once loved.
basic_info.core_demands: I really want to enjoy classical music again and reconnect with my grandchildren over classical music.

core_beliefs: One bad experience means everything will be terrible from now on

special_situations.event: Heard a highly recommended but disappointing classical music work (about a month ago)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If a highly recommended piece is terrible, then the entire classical genre isn't worth expecting
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Stopping contact with classical music, instead distracting attention with other activities
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Classical music is all terrible; listening again will only disappoint me

special_situations.event: When considering trying new classical music works
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I try again, I will be disappointed again and feel even worse
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids in advance; refuses to start playing; delays or cancels listening
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This song will definitely be terrible too

special_situations.event: When the opportunity to listen to classical music with the grandchildren arises
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I show disappointment, it will damage the bond with my grandchildren
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Refuses or avoids listening together with the grandchildren, keeping distance to avoid embarrassment
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will disappoint them; such time together will only get worse

special_situations.event: Others recommending new classical repertoire to me
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If previous recommendations all disappointed me, then new recommendations will be just as bad
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Negating or ignoring recommendations, refusing to try
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Recommendations aren't trustworthy; I'll be disappointed again

core_conflict.wish: Longs to enjoy classical music again and maintain close connection with family (grandchildren)
defense_goal: Protects himself from disappointment and negative emotions through avoidance and lowering expectations

object_relations.self_representation: A hesitant listener influenced by one negative experience
object_relations.object_representation: Classical music (or the recommender) is a source that may disappoint me

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited or suggested to listen to new classical music works, or to listen to music with the grandchildren
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: The client subconsciously equates 'trying again' with 'inevitably being disappointed again', understanding suggestions as a potential threat to their own emotions
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Emphasizing the past negative experience in an euphemistic and cautious tone, offering reasons like 'it will probably all be bad from now on', 'now isn't the right time', avoiding committing to try; steady pace, low emotional intensity, polite but not engaging deeply.

manifestations: The classical music once cherished has lost its appeal and meaning
Feeling less pleasure in leisure life
Decreased sense of connection with my grandchildren from no longer listening to classical music together
Feeling a shared hobby has been cut off

positive_force: Years of positive experiences and memories with classical music
Close relationship with grandchildren, emotional support present
Has awareness of his own thinking patterns and is willing to try change (positive attitude)
negative_force: Cognitive distortions like catastrophizing, overgeneralization, predicting the future, mental filtering, and disqualifying the positive
Avoidance behavior further reinforcing negative expectations
Presetting negative outcomes before new experiences, lowering motivation to try

antecedent: Thinking about listening to new classical music works
Planning to listen to music with the grandchildren
Recalling that disappointing piece of work
target_behavior.core_reason: Overgeneralizing one disliked piece into a negative judgment of the entire genre, and catastrophically predicting future listening to avoid disappointment again
target_behavior.function: Avoids possible disappointment and negative emotions, maintaining short-term psychological safety
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased fun and mood; avoiding listening affecting connection with my grandchildren; but work performance not yet affected
